A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TableMaster study and contain complete main text, references, and Appendices A–R. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison, including equations, tables, figures, and graphical prompts.

before.justification: v4 reports original TableMaster benchmark evaluations, component ablations, efficiency measurements, and supplementary analyses in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v6 retains these original empirical results, including TableMaster evaluations on five datasets and the ablation and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The TableMaster pipeline in Section 4, reconstruction algorithm in Appendix J, full-table reasoning procedure in Appendix M, and prompts in Appendix O are identical.

E1.justification: Both evaluate WikiTQ, TabFact, FetaQA, HiTab, and FinQA. The noisy-table scenario, hierarchical-table evaluation, free-form QA, and financial numerical reasoning coverage are already present in v4.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments, including Binder, Dater, Chain-of-Table, PoTable, the HiTab MultiCoT variants and E5, and the prompting and self-consistency comparisons.

E3.justification: The versions retain identical model configurations, sample counts, splits, preprocessing, metrics, and testing procedures. This includes the challenge-analysis settings in Appendix D and the 100-example TabFact efficiency comparison in Appendix I.

E4.justification: Table 2 ablations, noisy-table tests, table-size and peek-size analyses, efficiency measurements, reconstruction and adaptive-reasoning analyses, full-table comparisons, and case studies are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The single-inference reporting in Table 1 and inference-count comparisons in Appendix L are unchanged. v6 introduces no additional repeated-run, seed, uncertainty, or significance reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains GPT-4o-mini TableMaster accuracies of 78.13% on WikiTQ and 90.12% on TabFact; appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The task formulation and equations in Section 4, computational-cost derivation and Equation (1) in Appendix I, and notation in Appendix Q are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same four challenges, integrated TableMaster framework, adaptive-reasoning contribution, and performance claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of verbalization, reasoning strategies, information loss, efficiency, and FetaQA metric limitations are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same applicability boundaries, limitations, and future directions.

D1.justification: Model identifiers, hyperparameters, dataset access information, implementation descriptions, and appendix prompts are unchanged. The added acknowledgment mentions organizational resources without supplying technical or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions, research positioning, citations, and reference entries are unchanged. Bibliographic entries shift across pages following the acknowledgment addition; no cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: v6 adds Hanbing Liu’s email to the author block and a short Acknowledgments section between the conclusion and references describing internship context and organizational support. The scientific narrative and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block changes slightly, and the new acknowledgment causes reference reflow and spacing changes on pages 10–15. Scientific figures, tables, captions, and all appendix page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v6 adds an author contact and a generic acknowledgment, with associated layout adjustments. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. These additions produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
